content.json:
# Warden
Runs, agents, models and services, from Application Insights. The same questions as the local Grafana dashboard; histograms show averages and maxima here (Azure Monitor sends no buckets).

content.title: Runs by outcome
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "warden.runs"
| extend outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome)
| summarize runs = sum(valueSum) by outcome
| order by runs desc

content.title: Why runs went to a person
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "warden.escalations"
| extend reason = tostring(customDimensions.kind)
| summarize escalations = sum(valueSum) by reason
| order by escalations desc

content.title: Runs over time
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "warden.runs"
| extend outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome)
| summarize runs = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 1h), outcome

content.title: Time per graph step (seconds)
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "warden.agent.duration"
| extend step = tostring(customDimensions.step)
| summarize average = round(sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount), 2), slowest = round(max(valueMax), 2),
            steps = sum(valueCount) by step
| order by average desc

content.title: Model tokens by agent
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "warden.llm.tokens"
| extend agent = tostring(customDimensions.agent), token_kind = tostring(customDimensions.kind)
| summarize tokens = sum(valueSum) by agent, token_kind
| order by tokens desc

content.title: Time per model call (seconds)
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "warden.llm.duration"
| extend agent = tostring(customDimensions.agent), route = tostring(customDimensions.route)
| summarize average = round(sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount), 2), slowest = round(max(valueMax), 2),
            calls = sum(valueCount) by agent, route
| order by average desc

content.title: Risk scores the risk agent gave
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "warden.risk.score"
| extend route = tostring(customDimensions.route)
| summarize average = round(sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount), 2), lowest = round(min(valueMin), 2),
            highest = round(max(valueMax), 2), scored = sum(valueCount) by route

content.title: Policy decisions
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "warden.policy.decisions"
| extend decision = tostring(customDimensions.decision), principal = tostring(customDimensions.principal)
| summarize decisions = sum(valueSum) by decision, principal
| order by decisions desc

content.title: Consistency: spread of repeated scores
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "warden.consistency.spread"
| extend agent = tostring(customDimensions.agent)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, value) by agent
| project agent, spread = round(value, 2), measured = timestamp

content.title: Requests each service served
content.query:
requests
| where name !has "health"
| summarize requests = count(), failed = countif(success == false),
            average_ms = round(avg(duration), 1), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 1) by service = cloud_RoleName
| order by requests desc

content.title: Calls between services
content.query:
dependencies
| summarize calls = count(), failed = countif(success == false), average_ms = round(avg(duration), 1)
            by from = cloud_RoleName, to = target
| order by calls desc

content.title: Failed requests
content.query:
requests
| where success == false
| project timestamp, service = cloud_RoleName, name, resultCode, duration, operation_Id
| order by timestamp desc
| take 50

content.title: The backend's step log
content.query:
traces
| where cloud_RoleName endswith "warden-backend"
| project timestamp, message
| order by timestamp desc
| take 50
